data.long_meaning: Deba (God) + Brata (gift) – The name Debabrata is a combination of two words, Deba meaning God and Brata meaning gift. This name is given to a child who is considered a gift from God. The name Debabrata carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debabrata usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
